children: Leading Collision Repairers, G&C Auto Body and VIVE Collision Extend Use of OEM Build Sheet Data from CCC
CHICAGO, Sept. 15, 2026

-- CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC), a leading SaaS and AI platform provider powering the insurance economy, today announced strong momentum for its CCC® Build Sheets solution, with growing adoption across its collision repair network and recent renewals from multi-store operators including
and

Launched to help repairers make more informed decisions and work more efficiently, CCC® Build Sheets integrates VIN-specific vehicle data, such as manufacturer-installed options, trim packages, paint codes, and parts information, directly into the CCC ONE® platform. By automatically surfacing vehicle-specific information during estimating and repair planning, the solution helps reduce manual research, minimize errors, accelerate parts ordering decisions, and support more complete estimates from the start.

“In collision repair, access to vehicle-specific repair data at the start of the estimate drives everything that follows,” said Mark Fincher, vice president of product management for CCC. “With CCC Build Sheets, we’re helping repairers access the right information upfront so they can reduce rework, improve repair planning, and deliver more consistent outcomes for customers.”

As repairers face increasing vehicle complexity and pressure to improve efficiency, adoption of CCC Build Sheets continues to grow across CCC’s collision repair network. Recent renewals from multi-store operators including G&C Auto Body and VIVE Collision reflect continued demand for solutions that help repairers improve estimate accuracy, streamline workflows, and drive more consistent performance across locations.

At G&C Auto Body, a 64-location collision repair operator serving Northern California, implementation of CCC Build Sheets has contributed to measurable improvements in estimating and supplement performance.

“One of the biggest challenges in collision repair is getting the estimate right the first time,” said Josh Crozat, process improvement officer for G&C Auto Body. “With CCC Build Sheets, our teams have better visibility into the vehicle upfront, including what was installed and which parts are needed, helping us reduce supplements and keep repairs moving. That translates directly into better outcomes for our business and a smoother experience for our customers.”

VIVE Collision, an 80-location collision repair operator serving the Northeast, recently renewed its use of CCC Build Sheets as part of its ongoing effort to improve operational consistency and efficiency across its growing repair network.

“Having access to vehicle-specific information early in the repair process helps our teams make better decisions from the start,” said John Jerian, vice president of central operations at VIVE Collision. “CCC Build Sheets has helped us improve estimate accuracy, reduce the need for supplements, and move vehicles through the repair process on average three days faster than before we used the CCC solution. As we've continued to scale our operations, it's become an important tool for driving consistency across our locations and delivering a better experience for both our teammates and customers.”

CCC Build Sheets leverages OEM and third-party data sources to give repairers a clearer view of the vehicle being repaired, helping standardize processes, reduce variability, and improve outcomes across locations.

“The industry doesn’t need more steps, it needs better information earlier,” added Fincher. “That’s what we’re focused on with CCC Build Sheets, helping repairers simplify the repair process while improving consistency and efficiency across their operations.”
CCC Build Sheets is available to CCC ONE users through cccis.com/marketplace.
To learn more, visit cccis.com/build-sheets.
